name: Text-X Pro
description: Text-X Pro is a minimalist, clean Bludit template for multipurpose website projects. A premium Bludit theme for minimalist blogs, with Bootstrap 5.3.9, SEO auto, blog and static pages, categories, tags, and search. Fast, flat-file, no database, easy install, responsive, and fully compatible with Bludit 3.22.0. One-time purchase, you own 100% of the source.

features.2: SEO auto with Sitemap, RSS, Open Graph, and Twitter Card.
features.3: Cover image ready for posts and pages.
features.4: Blog posts and static pages support.
features.9: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
features.10: Fast, flat-file, no database, easy install.
features.11: One-time purchase, you own 100% of the source.
